findings.summary: No production writer exists for .dd-evidence/regression-baseline.json: the gate collector only loads it (self_gate_evidence.py:357,512) and development_create records no baseline, so on a real awaiting_gate single obligation 6 fails closed and the self-gate derives REJECT until a baseline is hand-recorded. Spec allows 'gate-time or create-time' recording; neither is implemented. Pre-existing base surface (M3 line-side harvest, outside this diff's narrowed S12 scope) and fail-closed, so not blocking — but the positive self-APPROVE path cannot fire in production without it.

The final_review mutation experiment executes only when the stage outcome is APPROVE (dd_materializer.py:442); a REJECT final review seals no mutation receipt. Substance preserved — the gate's obligation 5 then fails on the missing receipt and delivers REJECT anyway, and the receipt exists exactly when it is needed to authorize an APPROVE — but the letter of S12.3 reads unconditional.
